platform: SPAIN CONTEXT (not a platform): IVA and management-fee regulation
segment: Reference facts for Spanish pricing design

markets.vat_note: Tickets to live cultural shows (theatre, concerts, cinema, circus, bullfights, museums) = 10% IVA (art. 91.Uno.2.6 LIVA); professional events/congresses/B2B training and professional sport = 21%; the platform's fee as an intermediation/tech service is generally 21% IVA, deductible for an organiser under the general regime (a Soundtix blog says this depends on the contract and invoice structure). Platforms quote either ex-IVA (Entradium, Vivetix, Notikumi) or IVA-included (Eventim.Light, Tuk Tuk, Soundtix).
markets.money_flow_note: Spanish consumer authority (Direccion General de Consumo, informative note Aug 2024): management fees for online show tickets must be included in the price shown at all times, itemised, a FIXED amount that does not vary with ticket price nor be a percentage of it for the same event (unless justified by additional services), only for services the consumer receives, not above the in-person extra costs. A source says Real Decreto-ley 4/2026 (10 Feb 2026) changed art. 20.1.c TRLGDCU to require the full final price including management fees (verify in BOE). OCU: 92% of analysed companies apply management fees, average surcharge 11%.
fine_print: A percentage buyer fee (Tuk Tuk 8-9%, Notikumi 5%, Eventim 3.5%) conflicts with the Consumo guidance of a fixed amount per event - relevant for Arena's Spain pricing
Competitor blogs (Soundtix) are not legal advice
